mechanism: Isocarboxazid is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) that can potentiate serotonergic effects; pantoprazole may have weak serotonergic properties and both drugs can increase bleeding risk through platelet effects.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms and signs of bleeding; ensure adequate washout periods when switching from/to other serotonergic agents; consider alternative PPI or H2-blocker if clinically feasible.
